GateControl collects location data to recognise the name of the connected Wi-Fi and to disconnect the VPN automatically in your trusted Wi-Fi networks, even when the app is closed or not in use. The location never leaves your device and is not stored. For this to work in the background, choose “Allow all the time” in the settings afterwards.

GateControl collects location data to recognise the name of the connected Wi-Fi even when the app is closed or not in use – only then can the VPN disconnect automatically when you get home. The location never leaves your device and is not stored. On the next page choose “Allow all the time”.

Check the connection step by step and report problems
The app checks step by step: internet, server, VPN tunnel, DNS, packet size and speed. This takes about half a minute. Data only goes to your own GateControl server.
